responsibility: Documents GCC machine-description files and the instruction-pattern language used by the RTL backend generators. In the internals manual it serves as the reference for @file{.md} syntax, @code{define_insn}/@code{define_expand} and related constructs, operand predicates and constraints, canonicalizations, splits, peepholes, attributes, iterators, substitutions, and parameterized pattern generation that drive instruction selection and assembly output.
